rotations.name: D: Durum wheat - Durum wheat
rotations.why: Durum wheat every year (monoculture): the same crop and calendar every season.
benefits: One sowing and harvest calendar to manage
risks: No legume or break crop in the rotation
Soil left bare between each harvest and the next sowing

rotations.name: E: Durum wheat - Fallow
rotations.why: Durum wheat one year, bare fallow the next (the traditional 'año y vez').
benefits: Only one crop to sow every two years
gaps: Water stored in the soil during the fallow year is not modelled
No verified net margin for the fallow year
risks: Soil left bare for the whole fallow year
